lines.zh: 我踩着水边的泥走过来。
lines.en: I come along the mud at the water's edge.
I stand taller than a doorway.
The wet mud gives under my feet.
I close in on the bank step by step.
I push through the reeds.
My shadow lies on the water.
Birds burst up as I walk.
I drag my steps forward.
I lower my head to sniff the water.
The bank has gone quiet.
I went around that stretch of mud.
I stand motionless in the shallows.
Water runs past my legs.
My breath comes heavy.
The reeds brush my shoulders.
My claws are sunk in the mud.
The sky stays grey.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里换了一只脚站着。
lines.en: I shift my weight to the other foot in the shallows.
I open my big mouth a little.
I stand far above you.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿就在这张嘴里。
lines.en: These teeth are in this mouth.
You carry a very strong scent.
Only mud lies between us.
You stepped back; the mud sounded.
I'm not a bit impatient.
Which way do you think you'll run?
I cock my head and study you.
That made me roar.

lines.zh: 我的皮上开了一道口子。
lines.en: A gash has opened in my hide.
Muddy water splashed everywhere.
I didn't strike back at once.
My shoulder feels heavy.
I lowered my head again.
This won't stop me walking.
Muddy water runs down from the wound.
That's far too small.
I don't take that sort into my mouth.
That won't fill one tooth gap.
Its smell is very faint.
I lean in and take a sniff.
I'd rather something alive.
I went around it and walked off.
You just keep it.
You struck my chest and bounced.
I didn't budge half a step.
Mud sprayed everywhere.
You're inside my shadow.
My body is heavy.
You were thrown to the water's edge.
I gave back half a step.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肚皮上，滑进泥里。
lines.en: You hit my belly and slide into the mud.
You'd better not try that again.
I lower my head and look at you.
This whole bank is mine.
I have never needed company.
Are you a creature of the water too?
Let's each hold a stretch of bank.
Standing together is interesting too.
Neither of us cares to talk.
This pool is enough for the two of us.
Shift a little that way.
It's quiet like this.
It'll be dark in a while.
I lower my head and take it.
This weighs far too little.
It's hard to bite into.
You dropped something by the water.

lines.zh: 我用大嘴把它拱进泥里。
lines.en: I shovel it into the mud with my broad snout.
It's covered in mud.
One sniff and I walked off.
I've pinned it with a claw.
It sank into the soft mud.
It's not worth anything.
You've stepped onto my bank.
The mud in the water has been stirred.
I swing my body toward you.
The distance between us is short.
You can run; I'll wait.
I lift one forefoot.
The mist on the water has thinned.
Your panting gets heavier and heavier.
I've got your bearing exactly.
The water offers you no way back.
The reeds won't let you through either.
I'm picking up my pace.
I still have three steps to go.

lines.zh: 三格高的身子，站起来就是一片阴。
lines.en: Three blocks tall, I cast a whole shade.
You stepped into my water's edge.
My claw marks are all over the mud.
Running won't change anything.
You've snapped the reeds.

lines.zh: 我听见每一根断的声音。
lines.en: I hear each one break.
I eat up the distance bit by bit.
You've backed into the shallows.
Shallow water does you no good.

lines.zh: 你在泥里的脚步越来越沉。
lines.en: Your steps get heavier in the mud.
I keep my head turned your way.
A few steps still lie between us.
Back up more and you're in the water.
Heavy breath comes from my mouth.
At last I stand before you.
Do you hear the reeds moving?
Here at last.
Three blocks tall. One bite is enough.
My claws sweep across you.
You were knocked clean away.
That impact pressed my full weight.
Your armor split straight through.
The water sprayed high.
You landed flat in the mud.
I draw my head back slowly.
I lift my foot and bring it down.
I'm over you now.
Can you move at all?
I held back on that bite.
You never got a sound out.
The mud has your boots stuck.
I put my strength into that.
You rolled at my feet.
I raised my foreleg again.
I stepped out of the water mist.
The mist on the wetland hasn't lifted.
Muddy water drips off me.
My body is both tall and wide.
I've flattened a patch of reeds.
My reflection on the water is huge.
Birds burst up in the distance.
I look slowly toward the bank.
There's a sound in the water, coming near.
My claws sink into the mud.

lines.zh: 我停住不动等了一会儿。
lines.en: I stopped and waited a while.
The mist hides only half of me.
Fire scorched my flank.
I crashed into the mud, spraying water.
The water closed over my head.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推得翻了过去。
lines.en: The blast rolled me over.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的皮发麻。
lines.en: That force numbed my hide.
There's less in this water now.
Lightning swept the water and lit it all.
